'''Evin Yarrow''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Eve Yarrow]] and the head of [[Yarrow Industries]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Acherin]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Evin, along with other entrepreneurs, joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in order to assist the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the very end of the war.
